visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in denim overalls holds a camera in selfie mode while sitting on a covered quadricycle. Two young girls with pigtails sit beside her, smiling and waving. They are on a paved path lined with lush green trees under bright daylight. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) Close-ups of the girls' faces show them talking excitedly. One girl wears a pink dress, the other a white blouse. The background shifts slightly as the vehicle moves along the tree-shrouded path. (3) The camera shows a man and an older woman from behind as they pedal the vehicle. A green canopy of trees covers the road. A child's hand reaches out into the frame from the left. (4) A young girl in pink holds a clear plastic cup filled with red watermelon juice and a white straw. She looks at the drink with wide eyes. The setting is still the moving bike path with greenery. (5) The girls are seen eating small round bird eggs on wooden skewers while seated. They use their hands to hold the food. The vehicle is parked or moving slowly near the edge of a wooded area. (6) A young girl in a pink outfit runs down a wide asphalt path towards a coastal area. The camera follows her from a low angle. The background reveals a rocky coastline and the ocean under a hazy sky. (7) At a rocky beach, the two girls play near the water's edge. One girl in white walks toward the incoming waves, while the other in pink squats on the dark sand. Large grey wave-breaker blocks are visible. (8) A top-down shot captures the two girls sitting on the dark sand, digging with their hands and playing with small white stones. Their movements are focused and rhythmic. (9) Back on the pedal bike, the girls appear lethargic. The younger girl has changed into a grey t-shirt and leans her head against the seat. The woman's face is partially visible as she talks to them. (10) The camera captures a golden sunset reflecting on the sea surface through a silhouette of trees. The movement suggests the vehicle is traveling away from the coast. (11) A pink background with a cartoon illustration of a girl holding a snack appears. The text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' is centered in white uppercase letters.
